Bases: Data

truncate(lower_bin_edge, upper_bin_edge, inplace=False)

Select a range of the spectrum.

Keyword Arguments:

  • lower_bin_edge – first bin edge to include.

  • upper_bin_edge – last bin edge to include.

  • inplace (bool) – if True, modify the current Spectrum and return None, if False create and return a new Spectrum.
